title: Close strict command exception lifecycle gaps
summary: Keep dispatch exceptions inside the strict command state machine and require durable failed, indeterminate, or explicit unresolved evidence before responding.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W01-002. A strict mutation can currently raise after possible side effects, fall through generic best-effort exception journaling, and return without a durable terminal or proven indeterminate marker.
behavior_before: Strict dispatch exceptions leave an accepted reservation plus a generic best-effort route exception; terminal-write failures report indeterminate without proving the fallback marker persisted.
behavior_after: Explicitly pre-mutation OperatorRouteError failures persist as replayable failed terminals, all unclassified dispatch exceptions persist as replayable indeterminate terminals, and any secondary persistence failure reports verified marker proof or an unresolved-evidence fault while the durable accepted reservation blocks the same identity. The shared client retains the identity for every indeterminate or unresolved outcome.

tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_local_api_process_commands.py: strict facade exception is a durable indeterminate pipeline.start terminal rather than a generic route-exception entry.
tests/webview/test_webview_api_client_command_replay_smoke.py: command_evidence_unresolved is ambiguous and retains the exact command identity for safe retry/reconciliation.

notes: Finding disposition: AUDIT-FIND-W01-002 is remediated and independently validated against current source, pre-fix red tests, immutable audit evidence, focused unit/HTTP/WebView fault injection, full desktop classification, generated checks, and strict packet coverage. Safety rule: only OperatorRouteError deliberately proves no mutation; all other dispatch exceptions are indeterminate. A successfully written terminal response is the replay authority. If that write fails, the already-durable accepted reservation remains the duplicate guard, while the response truthfully distinguishes verified lifecycle-marker persistence from command_evidence_unresolved. No representative real-media validation was required because all side effects and persistence failures were synthetic fixtures and media policy is unchanged.
